notes: v511 — the 📏 Know Your Share passport is now part of the printable one-page share report (the 🖨 button), sitting right under Key figures. Same numbers as the panel in the share detail view — they are computed by the same code, so the screen and the printout can never disagree: movement decile with its persistence credentials, what movement costs per $1,000 per day/week/month, both honest parcel sizes with each one's stop-out cost, the finest stop that actually exists at that price step, time to sell out at a tenth of normal turnover, and the worst stretch on record. If a share doesn't have enough history to build the passport, the report simply doesn't include the section — a missing passport is never faked. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
